- It imports `RecordSelectorController`, which is `with sharing` and takes generic SObjects. `RecordSelectorControllerTest` tests it.
- This chain is separate from the trigger chain.

## Dependency chain
```
AccountTrigger (before insert/update)
  └─ AccountTriggerHandler
       └─ AccountService

Flow Append_Billing_Country_to_Account_Name (before save, create/update)   [standalone]

recordSelector (LWC) → RecordSelectorController   [standalone]
```

## Caveats
- **Two before-save automations.** The trigger and the flow both run before save on Account insert and update. Salesforce runs before-save flows before before-triggers. The flow changes the Account name, so I would check whether the trigger or `AccountService` also reads or writes `Name`. I did not read the class source.
- **Dependency graph limits.** I could not query the Account object itself in the graph, so these links come from each component's own references. Anything that touches Account only dynamically, such as a generic SObject, may not show up.
- **Index scope.** The index may not cover every metadata type, for example workflow rules, process builders or other objects' triggers that update Account. An empty validation rule result could mean there are none, or that the type wasn't indexed. I can run an incremental refresh or read the class source if you want either checked.
